what: Chapter entrance motion breaks the engine's motion rules: drops run 800ms with built-in ease-out and an overshoot, and the folder 'squeeze' loops twice for 1.4s each with ease-in-out, scaling width (squashes the drawing's text).
evidence: rs-ch11.css:65-68: `ch11-drop 0.8s ease-out 0.3s` (from translateY(-34px), 70% overshoot to +4px), `ch11-squeeze 1.4s ease-in-out 0.3s 2` (scaleX 1 -> 1.06). Measured on played panels at 1280. Reduced motion and 'Animations: off' both stop them correctly. (crops deleted after the review; rerun tools/check_chapter.js --shots or the audit script to regenerate)
fix: `ch11-drop` -> `animation: ch11-drop var(--dur-move) var(--ease-out) 0.1s 1 both` with keyframes `from { transform: translateY(-12px); opacity: 0 }` (no overshoot); `ch11-squeeze` -> delete it, or one run of `var(--dur-move) var(--ease-in-out)` (an illustration loop that distorts labels has no teaching job).

what: Chapter entrance motion: a 900ms slide with built-in ease-out, and a 600ms 'pop' from scale(0.6) with a 1.08 overshoot, both over the 300ms UI budget and the 0.9-0.97 starting-scale rule. The class name `.pop-in` also shadows the engine's keyframe name pop-in, which is confusing for maintainers.
evidence: rs-ch12.css:76-79 `ch12-slide 0.9s ease-out 0.3s` (from translateX(-24px), opacity 0.2) and `ch12-pop 0.6s ease-out 0.6s` (scale 0.6 -> 1.08 -> 1). (crops deleted after the review; rerun tools/check_chapter.js --shots or the audit script to regenerate)
